oses: Windows x64 desktop WHQL (GeForce and RTX Enterprise distinguished)
scope.completeness: Discovered public listings/API responses plus historical tag candidates; discovery_gaps record unsuccessful or saturated searches. No claim of exhaustive NVIDIA historical publication.
scope.version_bounds: Numeric first/last available discovered version per OS, not original branch GA/EOL.
scope.selection: All discovered supported branches per box; explicit failure if pins/distinct versions are insufficient. Availability only, no driver/die or ABI qualification.

turing.evidence: MEASURED public support list includes GeForce RTX 2080 at 535.54.03. It does not state a family-wide minimum.
turing.floor_kind: DESIGN: lower edge of this sweep, not a global minimum
turing.scope: Representative product listing; later dies can need later exact versions. This is not per-die qualification.

blackwell.evidence: NVIDIA-authored migration guide states Blackwell CUDA workloads require R570 or higher. Linux 570.86.16 supported-products list includes RTX 5090/5080.
blackwell.scope: Necessary branch floor, not sufficient for every Blackwell die/product or feature. Later products can require later branches. Linux Blackwell requires open kernel modules.
